name: PublicWWW Search API
description:
The same search the website runs, returned as data, and the clusters of your account: save a set of sites, combine sets, extract values from their page source. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; tokens are issued at https://publicwww.com/profile/api and a paid plan is required. Applications can obtain the same token through OAuth 2.1 (authorization code with PKCE, client metadata documents instead of client registration): https://publicwww.com/docs/api/authentication/#oauth

At most 10 requests per minute per account, shared with the MCP server; a request over the limit gets 429 with Retry-After at once. Searches count against the plan's daily quota, which resets at UTC midnight.

AI assistants can use the same search through the MCP server at /mcp: https://publicwww.com/docs/mcp/
